'''Smugglers&#39; Bridge Tunnel''' was a vast underground tunnel located near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Chofin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carratos]]. The tunnel was wide enough to allow [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to pilot craft through.<ref name="EGTPM" />
